items.title: 9.1.1 Design Thinking (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.1.1 (PDF 208), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Design Thinking ek tareeqa hai jo humein kisi masle ko mukhtalif zawiyon (angles) se dekhna sikhata hai. Foran hal (solution) par kood parne ke bajaye Design Thinking kehti hai ke pehle masle ko gehrai se samjho. Is tareeqe ke paanch aham qadam (steps) hain: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype aur Test.

items: Empathize (doosre ki jagah khud ko rakh kar mehsoos karna): kisi aur ki jagah khud ko rakh kar us ke jazbat, zarooratein aur mushkilat samajhna. Misal: agar aap naya school bag design kar rahe hain to students se baat karenge ke unhein apne maujooda bag mein kya pasand aur kya na-pasand hai.

Define (masla saaf likhna): maloomat jama karne ke baad agla qadam masle ko saaf saaf bayan karna hai. School bag ki misal mein masla yun likh sakte hain: 'Students ko aisa bag chahiye jo halka, mazboot aur kushada (spacious) ho aur uthane mein aaramdeh ho.'

Ideate (khayalat sochna): ab brainstorming (zyada se zyada ideas sochna) ka waqt hai. Har mumkin hal sochein, yeh fikr kiye baghair ke woh perfect hai ya nahi. Maslan aaram ke liye extra padding wala bag, ya aise khanon (compartments) wala bag jis mein kitabein aur saaman tarteeb se rakhe ja sakein.

Prototype (saada namoona): prototype aap ke idea ka saada sa version hai jo jaldi ban jaye. School bag ke liye gatte (cardboard), kapre ya kaghaz se ek bunyadi model bana kar dikha sakte hain ke bag kaisa lagega.

Test (aazmana): aakhir mein prototype ko aazmayein ke theek kaam karta hai ya nahi. Students se kahein ke bag istemal kar ke feedback (raye) dein. Un ki baaton ke mutabiq behtari karte jayein, yahan tak ke aisa final product ban jaye jo masla hal kar de.

blocks.alt: Paanch dabbe ek chakkar mein, teer ghari ki sooiyon ki simt: 1. Empathize (students se poochein), 2. Define (halka, mazboot bag), 3. Ideate (padding, khane), 4. Prototype (gatte ka model), 5. Test (istemal aur raye). Test se laal teer wapas Empathize ki taraf: raye se behtar karein, phir dohrayein. Beech mein likha hai: school bag ki misal.
blocks.caption: Design thinking ke paanch marahil, school bag ki misal ke saath (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Design Thinking ka usool (principle) kaunsa hai (MCQ 2)? Is mein kaunsi technique aam hai (MCQ 4)? Is ki bunyadi tawajjo kis par hai (short question 2)?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 2: (b) human-centered approach (insan ko markaz banana). MCQ 4: (b) brainstorming. Design Thinking ki bunyadi tawajjo un logon par hai jo product istemal karenge: design se pehle un ki zarooratein gehrai se samajhna, phir unhi ke saath aazmana aur behtar karna.

items: Design Thinking: pehle masla gehrai se samjho, phir hal dhoondo.
Paanch qadam: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test; feedback se behtari jab tak masla hal na ho.
